data.yaml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  external_labels:
    monitor: tesis-ecommerce
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
runtime:
  gogc: 75
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
  - follow_redirects: true
    enable_http2: true
    scheme: http
    timeout: 10s
    api_version: v2
    static_configs:
    - targets: []
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - prometheus:9090
- job_name: core-api
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /actuator/prometheus
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__address__]
    separator: ;
    target_label: instance
    replacement: $1
    action: replace
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - core-api:8080
- job_name: checkout-service
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /api/actuator/prometheus
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__address__]
    separator: ;
    target_label: instance
    replacement: $1
    action: replace
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - checkout-service:8082
storage:
  tsdb:
    outofordertimewindow: 0
    retention:
      time: 15d
otlp:
  translation_strategy: UnderscoreEscapingWithSuffixes
  label_name_underscore_sanitization: true
  label_name_preserve_multiple_underscores: true
